# Coaster Map

> Coaster Map (coastermap.com) maps and describes the roller coasters at major theme parks: height requirements (from official park pages), stats (from RCDB), intensity, who each ride suits and seat guidance. 458 coasters at 56 parks as of 10 Nov 2026.

Not affiliated with any park. Ride rules change; confirm with the park.

## Tools
- [Ride height checker](https://coastermap.com/height-checker/)
- [Coaster map](https://coastermap.com/map/)
- [Which coaster should you ride? quiz](https://coastermap.com/quiz/)
- [All coasters](https://coastermap.com/coasters/)
- [Sources and methods](https://coastermap.com/methodology/)
